notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.0.21 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The grind never ends! We've fixed some of the most critical issues with the Working From Home update!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where The Impostor could become invincible and also unable to damage Jackie, soft locking the run
[*] Fixed an exploit causing Team Player to make Jackie invincible while accompanied by certain invincible companions
[*] Prevented players from getting permanently stuck out of bounds in Cubicle Tower
[*] Fixed an issue where bringing Disaster Proof into Cubicle Tower as your pinned skill would break the game
[*] The Employee Kiosks in Fizzle now properly open the Resume again instead of the Rolodex
[*] Corrected a few typos in dialogue
[/list]

All these fixes will be coming to consoles along with the Working From Home Update itself in a matter of weeks! Thanks for your patience, and happy interning!

notes.title: The Working From Home Update is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/7581f720555fa90f377a2b9fa4c6f4005eaeafc2.gif[/img]
[i]literally us rn[/i]

[h2]CONTENT CONTENT CONTENT[/h2]
What’s poppin bebs! We just launched the Working From Home update for Going Under. That’s right, it’s out RIGHT NOW! You can PLAY IT! (Coming to consoles ASAP, we promise!)

For this update, we wanted to address some of the biggest gaps we and the players saw in the gameplay, to make it a better experience for people playing for the first time, as well as add content to give experienced players something new to tackle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/077ccc707eb4b533f45bdac8b73371be41f7987f.gif[/img]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5PUwQYBM_uc][i]Also watch our sick new animated trailer!![/i][/url]

[h2]Impostor Syndrome[/h2]
To that end, the biggest feature in this update is IMPOSTOR MODE. A lot of players have been asking for the ability to play the dungeons one after the other in more of a “True Roguelike” setting, so we’re giving the people what they want! Not only can you challenge the game’s core 3 dungeons in a single run, you’ll get to banish a new final boss: The Impostor.

To unlock Impostor Mode, you’ll need to beat the game’s first 4 dungeons, and then encounter The Impostor in a normal dungeon run. We’ll let you figure out the rest ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/940e212262545c2164339709a7ae654a213774bb.gif[/img]

Not only that, but there are 7 levels of Overtime, our scaling difficulty system similar to Slay the Spire’s Ascension. And they get STUPID hard. Even experienced interns will be at this one for quite a while.

[h2]But wait, there's more![/h2]
Easily the most requested feature was the ability to play old dungeons that get locked off for plot reasons. We’re finally caving to public opinion and letting you play the original 3 dungeons whenever you want with the flick of a lever! No more grinding the insanely hard dungeons to get your mentorships finished.

We’ve also got the Rolodex, our game’s version of a bestiary. By picking up business cards in the dungeon and capturing enemies in them, you’ll be able to learn more about the game’s lore, or just read whatever stupid jokes Caelan felt like putting in there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/bdb88ff9ccf0ffac35fb315d1241b2cab6edfc42.gif[/img]
[i]Nick wrote only one out of 57 and it was this one[/i]

Feel like taking a break? Jackie now has a room to hang out in! You can change outfits (yes, there are OUTFITS!), listen to the songs you’ve heard in-game, and start Impostor Mode runs from the comfort of your own room.

Finally, there’s a whole bunch of new Skills, Curses, weapons, and secrets to discover in the existing game as well as Impostor Mode. There are now a total of 99 Skills in the game! Can you get them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/0d5068774de7e3ef74562e841cbbdfd9ebb9c1c6.gif[/img]
[i]Good luck babyface, looks like you'll need it.[/i]

We worked our butts off on this update, and we really hope you guys have fun with it. It couldn't have been done without the amazing community and the passion you guys have shown for the world of Going Under, so thank you!!! (Random thought...we're only 40 reviews away from an Overwhelmingly Positive hmmmmːGoOverː) Til next time, when we'll have even more hype stuff to share.

<3 ːAggroCrabː

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Full patch notes are below! As always, let us know what you think of the update in the comments or in our [url=discord.gg/AggroCrab]Discord[/url], or even just @ us on [url=twitter.com/AggroCrabGames]Twitter[/url].
[h3]Major Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jackie’s Room can now be unlocked, allowing access to costume selection, an OST player, and the new gamemode: Impostor Mode.
[*] Impostor Mode: Run the 3 main dungeons one after the other, and face down your Impostor in this “True Roguelite” mode. Beat the additional difficulty options to earn new costumes!
[*] Rolodex: Capture your enemies in business cards to learn more about them! Complete your co-workers’ mentorships to unlock their cards as well.
[*] Old dungeons can now be accessed in the latter half of the game by pulling the levers near the slides in Fizzle.
[*] 25 new Skills to unlock and find in the dungeon
[*] 9 new Curses for the Hauntrepreneur to challenge you with
[*] 24 new items to wield, including the fabled [b]Legendary Weapons[/b]
[*] A new app -- Cubicle Reverb
[*] A new flavor of Fizzle??
[*] Added your best time successfully clearing a dungeon to the stats card on the entrance slide.
[*] Some new secrets to discover 👀
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the trigger odds of Win Friends & Influence Monsters and Aggro Crab’s Blessing.
[*] Reworked the order that Skills are unlocked in, including changing which Skills are available on a fresh save file.
[*] The Hauntrepreneur’s Shop no longer has a chance to spawn 2 health upgrades.
[*] Weapon prices in shops no longer increase as much as you descend through the dungeon.
[*] Extended spear hitboxes across the board
[*] Nerfed Beggar Queen, buffed Penny Puncher
[*] Decreased the global app spawn chance very slightly.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allied monsters will no longer spawn directly on top of you when entering a new room, fixing several issues such as being immediately ignited by friendly Devil Slimes
[*] Dodging damage by rolling or via certain Skills will no longer decrease your rating in Winkydink dates.
[*] Fixed a few issues where NPCs would say their lines in a weird order
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck outside the playable area in the final dungeon
[*] Fixed one of Hover Hands’s hands being immune to projectiles
[*] Fixed an issue where you could die after killing certain bosses
[*] Fixed an issue where certain bosses could be killed during their intro cutscenes
[*] Fixed an issue where Exit Strategist could destroy the exit slide, soft locking the run
[*] Fixed an issue where the Elite Winkubus wouldn't do her melee attack
[*] Fixed countless minor edge case issues and we don't remember them all lol
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.4.5: The Bug Slaying Patch
notes.content:
ːJackie7ː [b]The Bug Slaying Patch (v.1.0.4.5)[/b] is now live on Steam, and it’s only like, 3 weeks later than we told Discord it would be! The main point of this patch is, obviously, to fix the most critical bugs in the game, but we’ve also done quite a bit of balancing work, removed exploits, and even added a sneaky lil feature here and there. Turns out the QA team isn’t happy when you do that, though. Shout out to those folks for putting up with us.

All this stuff is coming to consoles in the upcoming weeks! Stay tuned.

[h2]ːGoOverː Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an option to turn off the jitter effect in the menus (This was meant to be in to begin with whoops)
[*]You can now control the menus with your controller’s D-pad
[*]There is now a menu option to change between holding the trigger & pressing it to toggle Focus
[*]Attempting to swap inventory slots while attacking or dodge rolling will now buffer the input and swap the weapon once the action ends
[*]“Attack Speed Up” buff now improves the reload time of projectile-type weapons
[*]Added an option to view the credits from the title menu
[*]The dialogue before founder boss fights will now be skipped if you already have their share.
[*]Added the option to invert the camera’s X-Axis control.
[*]Enemies should no longer spawn so close to the player when they first enter a new combat room.
[*]Screenshake algorithm has changed to have a smoother falloff and less intensity when smacking a bunch of environment objects. Try it out!
[*] Confidence Juice and Tappi’s max-level mentor bonus now play music to let you know how long they last.
[*]You can now date the Slime Hand in Winkydink. “Just like real life. -Nick”
[/list]

[h2]ːGoUnderː Balance Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made earning 5 stars in the Styxcoin Event slightly more lenient
[*]Nerfed the Rifle from 100 shots to 80
[*]You can now use SelfCare+ at max HP and it will grant 2 armor instead of 1
[*]Beggar Queen’s damage bonus has been reduced slightly, and no longer applies to unarmed attacks.
[*] Purchase Protection now only triggers on cash purchases of $10 or more.
[*] Fern’s vending machine will stop working after buying 3-6 cans.
[*] Removed Upcycle+’s old “replacement” functionality and instead made it increase the size of the held item (to potentially hilarious effect)
[*] Slime Hand’s scissor attack has been made a bit easier to avoid.
[*]Extended the length of Retaliatory’s damage buff from 2 seconds to 3.
[*] Fire Grates in Winkydink now turn off when the combat concludes.
[/list]


[h2]ːJoblinː Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where extra connected controllers would fail to function (and even some keyboards & mice from the future would cause this)
[*]Fixed an issue where force closing the game during Ray’s “app announcement scene” could prevent apps from unlocking for the rest of the game
[*]Prevented Eclaire from glitching into walls & floors
[*]Fixed issue where walking Eclaire or possessing a debt ball would cause you to teleport around when riding a vehicle.
[*]Fixed an issue where dollars wouldnt succ to Jackie if she was Downsized
[*]Fixed an issue with a rare Winkydink room containing a weird hat with no weapon icon
[*]Fixed an issue with the Resolution setting in the options where it would only say "1920x1080"
[*]Fixed an issue where enemies wouldnt spawn in a certain room in Styxcoin
[*]Fixed an issue where the options menu showed that the scroll wheel is how to Switch Focus Target on mouse/keyboard. The actual way is with the 1 and 2 keys.
[*]Fixed an issue where the calculator would display as a 2 damage item but hit for 4.
[*]Over-protective now works properly when used as a Pinned Skill
[*]NPC’s names now appear properly in dialogue scenes
[*]Steam achievements relating to completing mentorships now work properly. If you’ve already reached level 4 with a mentor and failed to get their achievement, completing a dungeon run (or just entering a dungeon and abandoning) should grant you the achievement.
[*]Fixed an issue where using Ray’s max-level mentor bonus once would break it (and some other things) until the game was restarted
[*]The Hauntrepreneur’s “shop” will now correctly sometimes spawn a briefcase full of cash instead of an empty slot
[*]You can no longer chill on Swomp’s couch multiple times in the same run
[*]The Styxcoin boss's death explosion will no longer hurt the player
[*]You can no longer exit Avie’s room once entering it
[*]Added a failsafe that should prevent soft locks caused by frozen enemies never unfreezing
[*] The briefcase in the Haunt’s garage will prompt the player to “Acquire” instead of “Buy” it
[*] Prevented Kara’s max-level mentor app spawning while using a different mentor
[*] Fixed a rare soft lock related to the Caffiend’s launch animation
[*]Changed the way Canbassadors spawn in the Caffiend fight, and eliminated the issue where they occasionally fail to activate
[*] Fixed an issue where Emotive would trigger from dodged/blocked damage, occasionally resulting in 1000 slimes spawning and crashing the game
[*] Team Player now reacts properly to the player taking fire damage.
[*] Prevented the player from defeating a boss and triggering the victory cutscene in the same frame as being defeated
[*] Companions now set themselves to either side of Jackie instead of right on top of her when entering new rooms, preventing an issue where you could be shoved into the void by your companions in certain dungeons
[*] Fixed an issue where only Forbidden Flavors would spawn once unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue where using Swomp's chill zone too much would break it permanently
[*] Fixed an issue where the hurtboxes of Hover Hands’ hands were inaccurate.
[*]Prevented an issue where completing a mentor level at the same time as getting the 3rd Share could soft lock game progress until restarted.
[*] Fixed cubes turning bright white when opened.
[*] Fixed an issue where picking up an app in a room that offered a choice between skills would despawn all the skills
[*] Removed a brief moment where the game could be paused during the final cutscene
[*] Removed a brief moment where the background would be visible after the credits ended
[*]Fixed various dialogue typos
[/list]

[i][b][h2]Various spoilers below. Read at your own risk![/h2][/b][/i]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[h3](Midgame spoilers)[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where Ferryman Hustlebones could fail to find his way to the topdeck, leading to easy damage against him.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where the 10x Caffiend’s big leap animation could get him stuck outside the playable area.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where upon beating the 10x Caffiend, the drone would drop the box outside the playable area.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3](Endgame spoilers)[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where traveling from Floor 999 to Floor 1000 of Cubicle Tower could sometimes grant you a Union Buster when you already had one.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Avie can no longer be damaged during cutscenes with specific skills[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Prevented certain skills from dealing bonus damage during the Avie fight[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Fixed Eclaire not being cursed in the end cutscene.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
[h3](Midgame Spoilers) Various Balance changes to [spoiler]Mask off Hover Hands[/spoiler]:[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]increased health of first and second phases[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]hands are invincible while clapping[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]less downtime between attacks[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]ice shuriken now targets you more accurately[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]some of the ice and fire grates in the room have been removed[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]graphical improvements such as new strobe lights, shiny nail polish, and a better cutscene animation[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3](Endgame Spoilers) Various Balance changes to the final fight:[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Slowed down lasers in the fight slightly, decreased their hitbox size, and increased the damage they do to enemies.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Increased Core’s cooldown slightly after using its explosion or punch attack[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Normal enemies during the first & second phase of the fight will take damage normally rather than dying after a certain number of hits. They will also spawn constantly, urging the player to kill them or get overwhelmed.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where the boss could knock Jackie down unfairly without playing the shockwave animation[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]After viewing Kara’s cutscene in the final fight, the associated cutscenes will no longer trigger during the same play session[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Increased the durability of the Union Buster[/spoiler]
[/list]


Header art by [url=https://twitter.com/100DARKSTAR]100DARKSTAR[/url]. We've been seeing some AMAZING FANART so if you've made any, send it our way via:

[url=discord.gg/aggrocrab]Aggro Crab Discord[/url]
[url=twitter.com/aggrocrabgames]Aggro Crab Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3.1 Live!
notes.content:
Hey Interns!

Launch has been incredible and we've been overwhelmed by the positivity but we wanted to get this update for the two biggest issues out as quickly as possible! Hotfix 1.0.3.1 is now live.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Capped FPS at 60 by default, and set the maximum cap at 120. This should resolve the persistent crashes for the majority of users experiencing them, and will serve as a temporary fix until we can address the underlying issue and hopefully allow uncapped FPS again.
[*]Buying an object with Blood Money will not restock it when using Tappi's mentor bonus, preventing an infinite health & skill exploit.
[*]Fixed an issue where going down a slide while holding Debt could duplicate the Debt.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Debt now drops when you dodge roll & encumbers your movement (although can still be swung fast) when using Upper Body Strength.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/e8d35a534c416276edfa66f9108a0be182fab5bd.jpg[/img]
[i]This bug hit a little too close to home[/i]

We're also still working on a bunch of other reports all you lovely people have submitted since launch! These updates are getting pushed much more rapidly to our [b]Public Beta Branch.[/b] If you wanna help us test our bugfixes and new features before they go out for everyone, the steps for downloading the beta branch are:

[olist]
[*]right click the game on your Steam library and select "properties"
[*]in the menu that opens, select the "betas" tab
[*]pick "public_beta" from the dropdown and let the games begin
[/olist]

Thanks to everyone that's taken the time to leave us a review, give us feedback and report issues. Have fun smashing monsters with junk and stuff!

notes.title: GOING UNDER IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h2]IT’S LAUNCH DAY!!!![/h2]
Holy s__t we actually launched. This has been a very weird journey working on a very weird game, and I am absolutely stoked for everyone to finally get a chance to play it!

Even before launch, this game has gone places we never dreamed it would go--with nearly 30,000 wishlists and over 9,000 followers on Twitter, the fan support has been absolutely unreal. Game dev can be a frightening, arduous process full of self-doubt, and it’s no exaggeration to say that this project wouldn’t have been possible without you all. From the bottom of our heart, thank you for taking an interest in our game and humbling us every day with your positive attitudes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/2431126ac779a21091a073e9060495512b5ffc69.png[/img]

[h2]We need a drink[/h2]
But enough of the mushy crap. Besides just generally walking around in the afterglow and chatting on Discord, Nick and Caelan will be hanging out on Twitch at 6PM PST today for a little post-launch debauchery. There will be drinking. There might be chicken nuggets. We just got Twitch Affiliate status on the Aggro Crab account, so if for some reason you wanna pay us MORE money, you can do that there too. It’ll be fun, come chill!

As always, the best place to discuss the game is on the Going Under discord! Tell us how much you love/hate the game! Tell us about all the very cool bugs you found! Post your thirsty fanfiction! The sky is the limit. 

[url=http://discord.gg/aggrocrab]Join the Going Under Discord![/url]
[url=http://twitch.tv/aggrocrabgames]Find us on Twitch![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/b3c057deddd7836a73f9b0dccf18e5076e6ea3b1.png[/img]

[h2]BANGERS[/h2]
As a side note, I’d be stupid not to mention the game’s incredible OST here! Composed by King Felix with a special bonus track from Chong the Nomad, it’s 29 sick tracks of Going Under goodness to let you feel like you’re interning even on your day off! You can buy it separately or as a bundle with the game on Steam! Go nutssss

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/8c49b8af10bf2ea390b2bc67bf0c00ce6971cf69.png[/img]

[h2]RIP Mac[/h2]
A short admission of guilt: We mentioned offhand to some of our Discord users that we were hoping to have the OSX version of Going Under ready on launch day. As you may have noticed, that…didn’t happen. It’s totally our fault, we’re inexperienced with releasing games on Mac (and especially the new requirements that have popped up in the past year) and we vastly underestimated the time required. That’s on us, and we’re going to do our best to get the OSX version on Steam as soon as possible, hopefully during October.

[h2]Stay tuned...[/h2]
Now, let’s briefly talk about THE FUTURE. A lot of players have been asking what’s next for Going Under after we launch, and I’m pleased to say we have not one, but TWO free content expansions planned for the game. So assuming our company doesn’t literally Go Under sometime in the next few months, you’ve got a lot more internship to look forward to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/04acff1b5f11348f6da2cab9198a69547167fe38.gif[/img]
[i]This is a card from the Bestiary!!!! It’s coming!!! we promise!![/i]

These future patches will include not only new content, but also plenty of bugfixes & community suggestions! So if you’ve got any cool ideas for the game, accessibility concerns, or bugs you’ve found, don’t hesitate to let us know on Discord!

We’ll be posting the Going Under Roadmap sometime in the next few weeks to make this all official--until then, we hope you enjoy the base game!

See you in the dungeon, interns!

[b]- Aggro Crab[/b]



[h3]P.S. THE HOMIE DISCOUNT[/h3]

We're offering a 20% launch discount for players with Slay the Spire or Undermine in their library!!

Before covid we shared an office with these devs, I think if you like them you'll like us too<3

notes.title: Devlog #5: Credit where credit is due.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/e0cbee0f3e737212b1770c9a69dcbd648150c29d.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, Nick here! With launch approaching (SEPT 24th!!!!) and all you new uninitiated followers to impress upon, I thought I’d take a sec to express my appreciation for the incredible work of the fine folks involved in the development of Going Under<3  (Note, I am copy and pasting this thread from twitter, if you prefer to read it there [url=https://twitter.com/AggroCrabGames/status/1308168002123173888]click here[/url])

[h1]Luiz[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/melluizo]@melluizo[/url]
Starting with Luiz, our 2D artist. We knew with our art style we needed someone who could pull off that wiggly colorful techy aesthetic, and he friggin nailed it. Based in Brazil, Luiz was the only remote member of the dev team but hopefully one day we cross paths irl<3

[h1]Sam[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/imadethisthing]@imadethisthing[/url]
When Sam filled the “Junior Coder” role it must have been some freakin’ miracle, cause he was anything but. Ontop of being a stellar dev who coded half the game, Sam quickly took the reins on designing the core loop, metagame, & balance. Like, with, spreadsheets!

A king of all trades, Sam even made the GU Logo! I seriously don't know where we'd be without him. It’s bittersweet cause with this project concluding, Sam is parting ways but he’ll always have the heart of a crab. We know he’s gonna kick ass at w/e he puts his mind to next 

[h1]Felix[/h1]
[url=http://soundcloud.com/ymirmusic]@ymirmusic[/url]

Our composer/sound designer; out of anyone on the team I’ve known Felix the longest. Many college nights were spent inebriated in his room vibing to beats he whipped up, so when I started my first game Smashy Brick, I had no choice but to get him for the music xD

So with Going Under, we just let him do whatever he wanted. Obv at first we couldn't figure out what the game’s music needed to sound like, but there was a point where Everything. Just. Clicked. From then on it was just banger after banger. And the sound effects too??? Felix!

[h1]Jobo[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/jobofish]@jobofish[/url]
As our prop/enviro artist & level designer, Jobo had to work directly with me the most, and for that I apologize! Jobo not only had the fatty endless grind of a responsibility of making the majority of the hundreds of items, skills, and obstacles in the game, but ALSO populating a bunch of rooms with them to create both aesthetically pleasing offices AND playable arenas. These rooms are so much of Going Under’s charm/vibes imo and that's all thanks to her. In the demo you’ll notice a lot of ‘Jobo’ weapons in Joblin and now you know why!!

[h1]Lulu[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/luulubuu]@luulubuu[/url]
Although she’s only been part of the team for two months, Lulu has already transformed the dynamic of the studio for the better <3 Her sense of humor and grasp of community has brought us all out of our shells a bit & prepared us for cultivating a lovely playerbase!!!!

[h1]Caelan[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/calenquest]@calenquest[/url]
What I appreciate the most about Caelan is that where I’m never sure about any decision I make, he can just be like, ‘I love that’ or ‘I hate this’ and I’m on board. Caelan is legit one of the funniest & most talented writers in games right now and I’ll ride or die with whatever words this mans puts to paper. Oh also he coded most of the game but he's not as good at that LMAO. Caelan, as co-founder and game co-creator, shares all my excitement/anxieties about the game that comes out in 3 days. It’s been a long road but we got this, dude!

[h1]Nick[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/SmashyNick]@SmashyNick[/url]
That’s me! I did the art direction, character models, rigs, animations, dialogue portraits, vfx, shaders, but then also all the studio stuff like bizdev, hiring, tweeting pre-lulu, merch, publisher relations, budgeting, payments, office upkeep, taxes. I’m tired. I'm not bringing up my laundry list to flex on the team, my point is it was a mistake on this project to not delegate more to others. Every time I trusted someone else to do something, their talent completely blew me away<3

Which means...next project needs a way bigger budget >:)

[h1]Team17[/h1]
[url=http://twitter.com/Team17Ltd]@Team17Ltd[/url]
And of course a huge thank you to Team17. Without you guys supporting us there would be no Aggro Crab and no Going Under. Special shouts to Rusty, Will, Ash, Louise, Christie, Ellie, the life-saving QA team, & of course head honcho Debbie :)

[h1]SPECIAL THANKS[/h1]
Mr. Dwyer if ur out there we smooch u. Steve for the clutch graphics. Chong the Nomad for the song.
Trevor for the merch. My roommate Galen the “Boss Battle Consultant”.

AND FINALLY THANK YOU FOLLOWERS AND FANS WE WON'T LET YOU DOWN<3 <3 <3

notes.title: Devlog #4: light at the end of the tunnel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/8524e28eb13685d5d78e4fbc22f727338b55bfbc.png[/img]
[i]the neon sign from our old office[/i]

[b]Devlog by Nick[/b]

Dude I miss this neon. I bought this on a whim at 3AM off eBay. It’s not custom for us or anything, I think it's probably mass-produced for seafood restaurants. Before things got weird, turning on this light was my ritual for when I carried my bike up the stairs into the office, made a pot of coffee, and got everyone sitting down ready for a morning meeting. Like at Krispy Kreme, the light being on meant we’ve got a hot fresh batch of donuts (game development energy?) to serve you up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/18779cd4ca19175c10c322e30467c020ea9550cc.gif[/img]
[i]had to get my fix[/i]

We’re extremely fortunate as game devs to be able to work from home in an industry largely unimpacted, if not somewhat boosted, by the pandemic. Aside from having to shut down the office, I really can't and shouldn’t complain. One thing quarantine has helped me appreciate though, is the importance of community.

As game developers we face a conundrum of making creative experiences for others through a process that makes us shy away into our holes. I am putting thoughts and feelings and experiences into the world via sitting at a computer for half of my twenties. This is a process I have found that I am wholly uninterested in. I can’t speak for everyone but I don't want to make blender models in a vacuum for all day and then show them off a year later when the game is out. That’s just...weird, it's too big, there’s too much time between the effort and the payoff. Sometimes it feels like other independent content creators, like Twitch streamers and YouTubers, are lightyears ahead of devs on how to connect with audiences because of their insanely fast turnaround time on producing content. Ultimately I think games are way more litty than those other mediums (that's why I'm still here), but there are things we can learn from them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/153c7dbe3a55b0170c26e068c99e79cbf22e1dbc.png[/img]
[i]team aggro crab in their natural habitat[/i]

We started this game a year and a half ago (which isn’t even a long time for games) and it goes without saying that the world is different now. In our current reality, does anyone really want to play a game anymore about businesses that have gone under? Are startups still funny? Is our game’s ending cutscene a little too on the nose now? Probably, yeah. I’m not actually worried about people not liking the story, it’s still hella good, just feels a little less relevant while still not exactly serving as escapism. I don't know! 

At Aggro Crab I think you can kinda tell from our freshman project that we want to be on the pulse of things. We like being political and making games that reflect our current times. We’re down to put a meme in the game even if it's cringe for everyone playing it on Games With Gold in 2022. No game is truly timeless, so might as well be timely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/c57ef3c4fbb85f7e45dab4e48dda8dd1523d3a75.jpg[/img]
[i]ok maybe some games are timeless[/i]

So on that note we’re makin’ a few changes around here!! I haven’t solved the problem of games-taking-time-to-make yet, but I think there are still plenty of ways we could better engage with our community. That’s why I’m pleased to introduce our new Community Developer, Lulu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/1bca56850179c70e6bf456b561ab7931771cf999.png[/img]
[i]uwu[/i]

Lulu is a social media mogul, she’s responsible for some of Twitter’s greatest hits, and now will be making social content for our game, managing the Discord, and much more! Expect improvements on all fronts as well as more noise from the rest of the team coming soon<3

Going Under is out in September!! (we had to push back launch two weeks but it's still gonna be September, funny how that works). Which means for us at least, the light is at the end of the tunnel. I’m more than anything stoked for you guys to play through what we’ve made, there’s so much in the game we haven’t shown. We’re so excited to come out of Moist Crack, bathe in the light of launch, and crawl right back in to work on DLC.

See you soon, interns. If you made it this far give us a wishlist, it helps out a lot<3

- Nick

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/c7828299e4e939b32ffc71a0856077406c9d8b23.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3: Hostile Work Environment
notes.content:
Howdy! I’m Sam, and I’m a designer and gameplay developer for Going Under. If you’ve played our demo (if you haven't, it's live now for the Summer Games Festival!), then you’ve gotten your beak wet in Joblin. And while you may have seen Sellswords, Freelancers, Chauffeurs, and Joblifters, there are over 30 more enemies (not including variants) that you have yet to see. I wanted to introduce you to some of them!

[h2]Joblin Freelancer[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/84abd7f1261592d5b92bd5e5ce24b9244ce77294.gif[/img]


So you’ve gotten killed by a freelancer. Maybe like 4 or 5 times. These guys are the first tough enemy you’ll come up against in Joblin. And to be frank, they’ll probably keep giving you trouble throughout your time playing Going Under. These guys start out with fairly short range weapons, usually holding thumbtacks and pencils, but by the time you reach floor B3, they’ll be holding long range brooms, spears, and tablet pens that can electrocute you!

Let me give you some tips! Do NOT just walk up to these guys charging an attack, they’ll punish you when you inevitably whiff. Before a freelancer strikes, they’ll first hop back, so hold off on your attack and let them make the first move! Using the Focus button can also help you keep track of them while they dodge around. 

[h2]The Winkubus[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/840fe08b9775c88c4134f38d9ee608b1b5f6cd27.gif[/img]


The most nimble enemy in the dating-app dungeon Winkydink, she flits around throwing projectiles at long range. If you’re in combat with one of these, keep your eye on her.

The Winkubus has one move in particular that WILL trip you up, and if you’ve ever dated online, you know this move well: getting ghosted! The winkubus will teleport around the room to get a better angle on you, and sometimes when you’re about to land a hit on her, POOF, she’s gone!
But her ghosting is predictable. She’ll often try to appear directly behind you to hit you with a projectile, so if you’re quick on your feet, you can turn around and punish her before she has a chance to attack. You can even stand in front of a hazard like a fire trap and force her to teleport right into it!

[h2]Kilobats[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/9270dfe7416673d3dd6482dd630fca73915ace36.gif[/img]


Styxcoin, the very real and very famous cryptocurrency, is quite literally mined from underground. And in these dank caves live Kilobats, little flying guys that deal death from above.
While they take the form of cute squeaky bats, and can often be easily dispatched with a well-placed folding chair, their attack can throw a wrench in your plans. When a kilobat is right above you, they’ll perform a loop-de-loop and come crashing into the ground with an electric blast.

Kilobats aren’t the most challenging enemy, but they ARE greedy. In Styxcoin, you’ll be collecting the STX cryptocurrency instead of dollars, and these bats love it. If you leave any STX lying around on the ground, they’ll beeline straight to it and gobble it up. This will leave you with less dough, which means you’ll have a harder time affording items from the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/7166365d0aa1034b58ce5f8556477440bddc39a2.png[/img]

Like I said, these are only a few of the many monsters you’ll come up against, many of which have multiple versions with cruel twists to make your internship a living heck. Hopefully these tips will come in handy, but mostly I’m excited for you to be stuck in a room with these suckers wishing you had 2 more hearts and a decent weapon.

Thanks for reading, that’s all I have for today!

- [url=twitter.com/imadethisthing]Sam
[/url]

Oh and by the way, our game is part of the Steam Summer Games Festival so make sure to try out the demo and wishlist here!

notes.title: Devlog #2: The World is Your Office
notes.content:
Hi folks! Caelan here, the writer & narrative designer for Going Under. I’m also a programmer and mechanic designer, but today we’re gonna talk about some more LORE, so no one cares about that nerd crap.

A lot of players have been tackling the Joblin dungeon in our demo--almost 10,000, actually! But there’s more to an internship than murdering monsters. It’s also about the connections you make! In this devlog, we’re gonna talk about some of Jackie’s co-workers at Fizzle Beverages, the company responsible for her hardships.

[h2]Marv
[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RNnmgka.gif[/img]

Those who played our demo will have already met Marv, the Project Manager directly responsible for Jackie’s internship duties. A friendly face to some and an insufferable micromanager to others, Marv’s true intentions at Fizzle are as inscrutable as his head is bald.

[h2]Ray[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tEV77El.gif[/img]

The founder of Fizzle Beverages himself, and Marv’s boss! At first glance, Ray might seem to be an egotistical airhead who made his fortune by sheer luck, but get to know him, and he might have surprisingly valuable insight about entrepreneurship. Maybe not. I don’t know.

[h2]Kara[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hqMl99a.gif[/img]

Kara’s the Lead Engineer at Fizzle, which means she spends most of her time managing the code for the website and prototyping Ray’s consistently [strike]terrible[/strike] inventive app ideas. But there’s more to Kara than that: she also has a deep [strike]hatred of technology[/strike] love for the outdoors!

[h2]Fern[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xqIjMfG.gif[/img]

Fern is the one in charge of all of Fizzle Beverages’ unique flavors, from “Sharkfin Pomegranate” to “Cajun Avocado” to ███████████! * An enigmatic man of science, Fern’s been at Fizzle longer than almost anyone else, and sometimes appears to value the pursuit of flavor above even human life itself! What a driven guy.

*Redacted by the Neo Cascadian Board of Food Safety

[h2]Tappi[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/795Zjm6.gif[/img]

Someone’s gotta keep the spending in check at Fizzle, and Tappi’s the one for the job! When she’s not sifting through paperwork, she’ll frequently be found trying to convince Ray not to spend 90% of the budget on ill-advised publicity stunts! If you’re looking for advice on how to balance a checkbook or deal with insufferable narcissists who hold your whole career in their hands, Tappi’s the one to ask!

[h2]Swomp[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u4UNJs6.gif[/img]

hey guys its swomp

That’s all the time I’ve got today! Hopefully we won’t wait another three months before updating this page again! See you sooooon

Oh by the way, we brought the demo back for the Team17 Publisher Sale!!

notes.title: Devlog #1.55 - September 2020 Release, Demo Returns and Console Announcement!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=bFDANin8uUk;full][/previewyoutube]
 
We're crazy hyped to announce that we’ll be bringing Going Under to Steam, Switch, PS4 and Xbox One this September! 

For all you fresh eyes, Going Under is a roguelite-inspired dungeon crawler about exploring the cursed ruins of failed tech startups. You’ll wield office junk as weapons as you battle your way through the forsaken office complexes. Stab a demon with a thumbtack one moment, run over a goblin with a smart car the next--your options in combat are constantly changing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/c3097e7f7219d596bebaf0ac97edd222e9611dda.png[/img]

Throughout your run, you’ll also learn skills that change the way you play! Harness powerful effects that can light a whole room on fire, turn enemies to allies, or just make your arms really buff or something. 

The story follows Jackie, a fresh-faced college graduate, as she begins her unpaid internship in the not-so-distant future city of Neo Cascadia. While she originally applied for a marketing job, it quickly becomes her duty to fight off monsters in the basement before they can disrupt workplace productivity on the surface. Her co-workers might not respect her yet… but in time, they might become her valuable allies as she hacks and slashes for the sake of her employer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/809c338b3c4f693fced034ecd0f84e410256506b.png[/img] 

Will you complete your internship alive? What will you learn about the startup that hired you, and their mysterious parent company? Can you save yourself from going under… for good? 

Going Under releases on all platforms September 2020! Keep your chin up, interns!
